knowledge_point.title: Determining the Rank of a Matrix Given the Number of Pivot Columns

question.:question/problem: Let $T$ be a $13\times 9$ matrix that has $9$ **pivot** columns. What is the rank of the matrix?
question.:question/worked-solution:
We know that $\text{rank}(T)$ is the number of pivot columns in $T.$ 

Since we are told that $T$ has $9$ pivot columns, we have 

$$
\text{rank}(T)=9.
$$

generation.domain: dimensions 3..15; positive rank <=12; non-pivot count positive; feasible rank <= min(rows,columns)
